findings.message: 2 headline(s) switch typeface or to italic mid-line (the "one italic serif word" move).
findings.fix: Set the whole headline in one face. Emphasis comes from the words.
Use the drawn palette. If you want warmth, take a low-chroma stone or bone, not a yellow cream.

findings.fix: Darken or lighten the text colour.

findings.message: 11 panel borders are dark against their ground: #9a927f on #f3ead8 (2.59:1) | #9a927f on #f3ead8 (2.59:1) | #9a927f on #f3ead8 (2.59:1)
findings.fix: A panel border is a whisper: about 1.1–1.3:1 against its ground on a light screen (#e5e7eb–#ededed on white), and about 1.2–1.5:1 on a dark one (#1a1a1a on #000, #2e2e2e on #111). Darker lines turn the screen into a grid of boxes; keep the stronger line for controls.

findings.message: 4 card(s) hold a blank band inside: 149px in "Loewe Puzzle", 112px in "Chanel Spring 2027 runway bags", 74px in "Chanel Classic Flap".
findings.fix: A card stretches to its neighbour only when it has content to fill. Keep a legend or a note directly under its chart (only an action or a total may sit at a stretched card's foot), let a short card keep its own height (align-items: start), and let a filtered block shrink to its rows.

findings.message: The h1 is 54px ("What needs a decision this month.").
findings.fix: An app screen is not a landing page: the title is 18-32px (20-24px on a phone).
